name: Rosemary's Crow
summary: A small amber-eyed crow will not leave Rosemary Langtree, and the town wants it gone.

stages.journal: Rosemary Langtree has a crow called Beak that will not leave her. The town wants it gone.
stages.hint: Ask Old Tom Crowley in the lanes what kind of crow it is, then see Rosemary.

stages.journal: Beak has a place now, or has gone.
